title: Sokkou Seitokai: Sonic Council
overview:
I can't afford to lose!

"Sokkou Seitokai", popularly serialized in the monthly "Comic Gamest", is turned into a full game! The writers of the arcade game magazine "Gamest" fully cooperated in its production! Now, the strongest versus fighting game in history is born!

At Jinsoku High School, the Sonic Council is run by four students with Tetsuwan, a superhuman "iron arm" fighting power. The council invites every Tetsuwan fighter in town to a tournament, with "the power of the universe" promised to the winner.

This 2D fighter uses six attack buttons. Chain light-to-heavy attacks into Sonic Combos, juggle opponents off the edge of the screen, and spend your motivation gauge on powerful Tetsuwan super moves or a Sonic Shift that teleports you around a guarding opponent.

- Story, VS, Survival and Training modes
- VS records charted per character, with a preset Gamest tournament data set
- One or two players, memory backup saves

負けるわけにはいかないぜ！

月刊「コミックゲーメスト」で好評連載中の「速攻生徒会」を完全ゲーム化！アーケードゲーム雑誌「ゲーメスト」のライター陣が製作に全面協力！今、史上最強の対戦格闘ゲームが誕生する！
